note.body:
# Garden day readiness report

The garden day can proceed outdoors, but the shelter decision remains open. Alex should confirm the shelter before inviting helpers to set up: the rain plan depends on that choice.

## Readiness

| Work | What is known | What remains |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables | The committee can lend 4 tables. | Alex must collect them on 2026-10-23. |
| Water | The shared tap works. | Helpers must bring watering cans. |
| Shelter | The hall is unavailable on 2026-10-24. | The committee has not confirmed the canopy. |

## Recommended next steps

Confirm the canopy before 2026-10-18. If it is unavailable, ask the committee for another rain plan before confirming the outdoor setup. Collect the tables on 2026-10-23 and tell helpers to bring watering cans. These steps depend on the committee's confirmation; this report does not treat an unconfirmed canopy as booked.

## Limits

The briefing does not give a canopy capacity, a hire price or a weather forecast. No conclusion about shelter capacity or cost follows from the available facts.

## Sources

- [[Garden day briefing.txt]]: table collection, water and shelter facts, dated 2026-10-10.
- [[Garden day]]: the shelter decision deadline and project context.
